main_theorems.name: CK.noiseOp
main_theorems.statement: def noiseOp {n : ℕ} (p : ℝ) (F : Cube n → ℝ) (y : Cube n) : ℝ := ∑ x, kernel p y x * F x

main_theorems.name: CK.noiseOp_chi
main_theorems.statement: theorem noiseOp_chi (p : ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (y : Cube n) : noiseOp p (chi S) y = (1 - 2 * p) ^ S.card * chi S y

main_theorems.name: CK.noiseOp_add
main_theorems.statement: theorem noiseOp_add (p : ℝ) (F G : Cube n → ℝ) : noiseOp p (fun x => F x + G x) = fun y => noiseOp p F y + noiseOp p G y

main_theorems.name: CK.noiseOp_const_mul
main_theorems.statement: theorem noiseOp_const_mul (p c : ℝ) (F : Cube n → ℝ) : noiseOp p (fun x => c * F x) = fun y => c * noiseOp p F y

main_theorems.name: CK.noiseOp_eq_sum
main_theorems.statement: theorem noiseOp_eq_sum (p : ℝ) (F : Cube n → ℝ) (y : Cube n) : noiseOp p F y = ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), (1 - 2 * p) ^ S.card * fourierCoeff F S * chi S y

main_theorems.name: CK.fourierCoeff_noiseOp
main_theorems.statement: theorem fourierCoeff_noiseOp (p : ℝ) (F : Cube n → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) : fourierCoeff (noiseOp p F) S = (1 - 2 * p) ^ S.card * fourierCoeff F S

main_theorems.name: CK.posterior_eq_noiseOp
main_theorems.statement: theorem posterior_eq_noiseOp (f : BooleanFunction n) (p : ℝ) (y : Cube n) : posterior f p y = (1 + noiseOp p (signOf f) y) / 2

main_theorems.name: CK.abs_noiseOp_le_one
main_theorems.statement: theorem abs_noiseOp_le_one {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (F : Cube n → ℝ) (hF : ∀ x, |F x| ≤ 1) (y : Cube n) : |noiseOp p F y| ≤ 1

main_theorems.name: CK.binaryEntropy_mean_eq
main_theorems.statement: theorem binaryEntropy_mean_eq (f : BooleanFunction n) : binaryEntropy (mean f) = eta (avg (signOf f))

main_theorems.name: CK.conditionalEntropy_eq_avg_eta
main_theorems.statement: theorem conditionalEntropy_eq_avg_eta (f : BooleanFunction n) (p : ℝ) : conditionalEntropy f p = avg (fun y => eta (noiseOp p (signOf f) y))

main_theorems.name: CK.conditionalEntropy_eq_avg_eta_abs
main_theorems.statement: theorem conditionalEntropy_eq_avg_eta_abs (f : BooleanFunction n) (p : ℝ) : conditionalEntropy f p = avg (fun y => eta |noiseOp p (signOf f) y|)

main_theorems.name: CK.cancellation
main_theorems.statement: theorem cancellation (p : ℝ) (F : Cube n → ℝ) : avg (fun x => noiseOp p F x ^ 2) - (1 - 2 * p) ^ 2 * avg (fun x => F x * noiseOp p F x) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((1 - 2 * p) ^ (2 * k) - (1 - 2 * p) ^ (k + 2)) * weight F k

main_theorems.name: CK.energy_lower_bound
main_theorems.statement: theorem energy_lower_bound {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1 / 2) (f : BooleanFunction n) (Ω : ℝ) (hcap : (avg (signOf f)) ^ 2 + weight (signOf f) 1 ≤ Ω) : (1 - (1 - 2 * p)) * ((1 + (1 - 2 * p) - Ω * (1 - 2 * p) ^ 2) - (1 + (1 - 2 * p) - (1 - 2 * p) ^ 2) * (avg (signOf f)) ^ 2) ≤ avg (fun y => psi (1 - 2 * p) |noiseOp p (signOf f) y|)

main_theorems.name: CK.fourierCoeff_comp_perm_singleton
main_theorems.statement: theorem fourierCoeff_comp_perm_singleton {n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (F : Cube n → ℝ) (j : Fin n) : fourierCoeff (fun x => F (x ∘ σ)) {j} = fourierCoeff F {σ.symm j}

main_theorems.name: CK.weight_one_comp_perm
main_theorems.statement: theorem weight_one_comp_perm {n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (F : Cube n → ℝ) : weight (fun x => F (x ∘ σ)) 1 = weight F 1

main_theorems.name: CK.weight_one_indicator_le
main_theorems.statement: theorem weight_one_indicator_le {n : ℕ} (f : BooleanFunction n) : weight (fun x => indicator (f x)) 1 ≤ mean f / 2 ∧ weight (fun x => indicator (f x)) 1 ≤ (1 - mean f) / 2

main_theorems.name: CK.balanced_first_level
main_theorems.statement: theorem balanced_first_level {n : ℕ} (f : BooleanFunction n) (hbal : mean f = 1 / 2) (hcoef : ∀ i, |fourierCoeff (fun x => indicator (f x)) {i}| ≤ 13 / 40) : weight (fun x => indicator (f x)) 1 ≤ 31 / 160

main_theorems.name: CK.lift
main_theorems.statement: def lift {n : ℕ} (f : BooleanFunction n) : BooleanFunction (n + 1) := fun y => decide (f (fun i => decide (y (Fin.castSucc i) = y (Fin.last n))) = y (Fin.last n))

main_theorems.name: CK.bias_inclusive_cap
main_theorems.statement: theorem bias_inclusive_cap {n : ℕ} (f : BooleanFunction n) (hm : |avg (signOf f)| ≤ 13 / 20) (hb : ∀ i, |fourierCoeff (signOf f) {i}| ≤ 13 / 20) : (avg (signOf f)) ^ 2 + weight (signOf f) 1 ≤ 31 / 40
